skonester_open_lifestyle_gui_effect = {
  skonester_cheat_menu_sync_lifestyle_target_effect = yes
  if = {
    limit = { exists = scope:actor }
    scope:actor = {
      if = {
        limit = { exists = scope:skonester_lifestyle_target }
        set_variable = {
          name = skonester_lsf_gui_target
          value = scope:skonester_lifestyle_target
        }
      }
      remove_character_flag = skonester_lsf_gui_open
      add_character_flag = skonester_lsf_gui_open
    }
  }
  else = {
    if = {
      limit = { exists = scope:skonester_lifestyle_target }
      set_variable = {
        name = skonester_lsf_gui_target
        value = scope:skonester_lifestyle_target
      }
    }
    remove_character_flag = skonester_lsf_gui_open
    add_character_flag = skonester_lsf_gui_open
  }
}

skonester_close_lifestyle_gui_effect = {
  remove_character_flag = skonester_lsf_gui_open
}

skonester_lsf_gui_sync_target_from_var_effect = {
  if = {
    limit = { has_variable = skonester_lsf_gui_target }
    var:skonester_lsf_gui_target = { save_scope_as = skonester_lifestyle_target }
  }
}

    limit = { has_variable = skonester_lsf_gui_target }
    var:skonester_lsf_gui_target = {
      if = {
        limit = { has_perk = no_stone_unturned_perk }
      remove_perk = no_stone_unturned_perk
      }
      else = {
      add_perk = no_stone_unturned_perk
      }
    }
  }
}
